correctness.rationale: A two-connector cycle must use all six available vertices by girth. This guarantees the private and spanning-tree collapse pairs remain free at deletion, even with intersecting hexagons. The residual dimension and connectivity control integral homology; duality and the complete two-skeleton promote the original complex to the stated integral wedge.
